hooks.name: Run the matching tests after a backend file is saved
hooks.description: Keeps the importer and estimators honest: any change to ingest/, analysis/ or tariffs/ reruns unit and property tests for that area.

action.command: cd backend && uv run pytest -q -x tests/unit tests/property 2>&1 | tail -15
cd backend && uv run ruff check src tests --output-format concise 2>&1 | tail -20
